parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the kettle, made of ceramic, fitting on top of the kettle body to cover the opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping and can be removed to fill or clean the kettle.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the kettle, made of ceramic, attached to the side of the body for holding.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and pour the kettle safely without touching the hot body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kettle, made of ceramic, forming the container for holding liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water or tea and withstands heat during boiling or serving.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and serves as the central structure connecting all other parts.
